messages:
oliver (support): Incoming major escalation: multiple customers reporting 502/504 and connection resets calling hosted inference since ~11:10 UTC. Biggest hits are enterprise accounts on high-concurrency plans. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/hosted/gateway/errors

sara (oncall): Opening war-room. Are errors concentrated on a route or spread? Any deploys in the last hour?

oliver (support): Primarily /v1/generate with large payloads (>4k tokens incoming), also some /v1/chat. No infra deploys logged in the last 2 hours per ops-bot.

ops-bot: No deployments detected in last 120m. Scheduled job: response-compression rollout started 10:58 UTC (job id: comp-roll-2026-07).

mina (sre): Looking at edge logs: large number of upstream 502s with worker-side connection resets. Also seeing OOM kill events on a subset of inference workers around 11:05-11:12.

carlo (eng-runtime): We pushed response-compression to inference workers in a staged rollout at 10:58 (intended to save bandwidth). It enables gzip on model outputs for payload > 1KB. We thought it was safe but didn't fully validate with long sequences.

lee (observability): Traces: https://traces.redwood/s/trace/comp-2026-07. Patterns: worker process memory climbs on large outputs when compression is enabled; compression attempts spike CPU and memory, causing OOM on some older instance types. That triggers process restarts -> gateway sees upstream resets -> 502/504.

carlo (eng-runtime): Reproduced locally: generate request that returns ~10MB payload triggers compression routine and memory spike up to 3.6GB on smaller instances, causing OOM. We underestimated peak output memory during streaming+compression.

sara (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) disable response-compression rollout, 2) scale worker fleet to replace OOM'ed nodes, 3) increase gateway upstream timeout to avoid premature 504s while workers restart. I'll orchestrate.

ops-bot: Rollback initiated: comp-roll-2026-07 -> disabled (requested by sara). ETA ~60s.

finance-bot: Alert: Billing API showing anomalous spike in retries for a handful of tenants (likely due to retries). Notifying finance.

oliver (support): Customers asking for temporary mitigations they can do client-side. Suggested: lower max_tokens, prefer streaming small chunks, exponential backoff. Sharing a mitigation note with affected tenants now.

mina (sre): Also enabling a per-route payload-size reject at the gateway to short-circuit huge responses until we have a safe compression config. Patch command:
```
kubectl patch configmap/gateway-config -n hosted --patch '{"data":{"max_response_bytes":"10485760"}}'
```
Applied for /v1/generate routes.

carlo (eng-runtime): Rolling back compression completed. Observability: OOM events stop within 2 minutes. Upstream 502s falling but some worker restarts cause trailing 504s.

lee (observability): Post-rollback metrics: error-rate dropped ~78% in 5m; worker memory pressure normalized after autoscaling replaced removed nodes. Still monitoring for edge cases.

sara (oncall): Immediate action summary (done):
- disabled response-compression rollout (carlo)
- patched gateway to cap response size (mina)
- scaled worker fleet to replace crashed nodes (ops-bot)
- customer comms sent with mitigation steps (oliver)

oliver (support): Customers appreciate rollback but want clear RCA and whether they'll get credits. Escalating to accounts/finance.

carlo (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: compression routine increased transient memory usage for large model outputs; on smaller instance types this pushed memory above process limits causing OOM. Rollout lacked a preflight test that simulates large outputs under compression.

carlo (eng-runtime): Repro steps in staging: 1) enable compression, 2) send heavy output requests (approx 8-12MB responses), 3) observe memory allocation spike during streaming+gzip, 4) process OOM and restart, gateway receives upstream resets -> 502/504.

lee (observability): Logs (sanitized):
```
[inference-worker] 2026-07-15T11:07:13Z WARN compress_stream: compression_buffer_alloc=2.7GB
[kernel] 2026-07-15T11:07:14Z INFO oom_reaper: kill process 21345 (inference) memory+swap
[edge-proxy] 2026-07-15T11:07:15Z ERROR upstream prematurely closed connection
```

sara (oncall): Follow-up action items (owners + due dates):
- carlo: implement memory-safe compression path (streaming chunked compression with bounded buffers) and add instance-type pricing guardrail that prevents compression on low-memory instance types (owner: carlo, due: 72h)
- mina: add preflight test in canary pipeline that includes large-output synthetic requests to validate memory & CPU under compression (owner: mina, due: 48h)
- lee: create dashboard per-instance-type showing memory pressure spikes during feature rollouts and alert when mem used > 70% for 2m (owner: lee, due: 24h)
- kai (platform): add rollout gating to require large-output smoke test pass before enabling compression globally (owner: kai, due: 72h)
- sara: update incident runbook to include steps for feature rollbacks tied to memory-sensitive paths (owner: sara, due: 24h)
- oliver: coordinate customer credit/impact table with finance and CS, collect request IDs (owner: oliver, due: 48h)

kai (platform): I'll add rollout gating and a canary hook to run the new large-output smoke tests. Will also add instance-type capability labels to avoid enabling compression on small nodes.

finance-bot: Created ticket BILL-2026-407 for credit review. Linking to incident INC-2026-0715.

mina (sre): Postmortem checklist: timeline with rollout job id, exact config diffs, memory & OOM events, customer impact window, repro artifacts, and safe rollback + re-intro plan. I'll draft the postmortem (due 48h).

oliver (support): Notifying customers we'll provide follow-ups and a plan for safer compression re-introduction. Collecting affected tenant IDs now.

sara (oncall): Tagging owners for follow-up: @carlo @mina @lee @kai @oliver. I'll post the initial postmortem in #incidents tomorrow morning for review.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0715 created: "Hosted gateway 502/504 spike due to response-compression rollout causing worker OOMs". Attach logs and traces.

oliver (support): Closing war-room when owners ack. Thanks team.

-- end of thread --
